from itertools import accumulate
from math import gcd


def best_average(a: list[int], k: int) -> list[int]:
    n = len(a)
    p = list(accumulate(a, initial=0))
    hull: list[int] = []
    head = 0
    best_num = p[k]
    best_den = k

    for r in range(k, n + 1):
        i = r - k
        pi = p[i]
        while len(hull) - head >= 2:
            i1 = hull[-2]
            i2 = hull[-1]
            if (p[i2] - p[i1]) * (i - i2) >= (pi - p[i2]) * (i2 - i1):
                hull.pop()
            else:
                break
        hull.append(i)

        pr = p[r]
        while len(hull) - head >= 2:
            i1 = hull[head]
            i2 = hull[head + 1]
            if (pr - p[i2]) * (r - i1) >= (pr - p[i1]) * (r - i2):
                head += 1
            else:
                break

        best_i = hull[head]
        cur_num = pr - p[best_i]
        cur_den = r - best_i
        if cur_num * best_den > best_num * cur_den:
            best_num = cur_num
            best_den = cur_den

    g = gcd(best_num, best_den)
    return [best_num // g, best_den // g]
